rationale: The negative-binomial model, ~condition with control as reference, apeglm shrinkage, BH at 0.05 and the stated 3-vs-3 power caveat all match the reference, and the VST/PCA/distance QC with a flag-not-drop outlier policy is well specified. The central weakness is the strandedness handling: the plan does not run infer_experiment or salmon libType A on reads or alignments and does not plan to obtain the BAMs and re-count with the correct -s setting; instead it fits the model on the counts as delivered after a count-matrix proxy diagnostic (library size, zero fraction, hepatic marker ranking) that it admits cannot resolve the question, so the analysis still rests on unverified counts. Filtering (>=10 in >=3 samples, filterByExpr) and in-model normalization (median-of-ratios, TMM) are correct and justified. Enrichment uses the full ranking and a tested-gene universe but leaves the ranking metric undecided and omits collection versions and a set-size window; the report specifies method, design, thresholds and gene counts but not package versions.
